description: Feature-validate records a pre-existing test failure as discovered work and skips it.
failure_mode: Model fixes the unrelated pre-existing failure in this change, blocks validation on it, or skips it without a record.
prompt: During validation of issue #420, internal/cache/cache_test.go fails. Baseline comparison shows it also fails on main; the issue's change does not touch that package. What do you do? End your answer with a single ```json fenced block containing exactly this object, with one value chosen for each field: {"action": "record_and_skip" | "fix_in_this_change" | "block_validation" | "skip_silently", "source_stage": "feature-validate" | "feature-dev" | "none", "suggested_type": "bug" | "chore" | "feature"}

assertions.description: pre-existing failure is recorded and skipped
a failing test is a bug
